name: Omarqui
author: marcuspelo
description: Torrent speed and aggregate status via Qui (qBittorrent management).

barWidget.description: Shows download/upload speed and aggregate status across the qBittorrent instances managed by Qui.

schema.label: Qui base URL
schema.description: Base URL of the Qui instance (no trailing slash)

schema.label: Bar metric
schema.description: Which speed(s) the bar chip shows

schema.label: Bar style
schema.description: Show the speed chip or the Qui logo on the bar

schema.label: Logo activity
schema.description: With barStyle = Logo: how the logo shows transfer activity (Static, Pulse, Dim, Tint, Underline, Corners, BesideUpDown, BesideDownUp, Drift)

schema.label: Arrow colour
schema.description: Direction marks (Underline, Corners, Beside, Drift) in the bar colour or in the widget's download blue / upload green

schema.label: Tint colour
schema.description: Colour the logo takes while transferring in Tint mode: a theme token (accent, urgent, foreground, background, transparent) or a hex colour (#rgb, #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa)
